comment: The Pulse feed. Metis Orchestrator's Pulse tab renders these sections; edit this file to publish. news[] entries may carry optional image + tag fields for the bento tiles.

changelog.title: MCP marketplace expansion: 12 more real connections
changelog.blurb: GitHub, Brave Search, Playwright, Puppeteer, Postgres, SQLite, Slack, Everything, Context7, Notion, Sentry, and Google Drive join the six starter MCP servers — all real npm packages, install with a click, then fill in your own tokens and paths.

changelog.title: Marketplace stocked: MCP, skills, and presets
changelog.blurb: The registry now ships real content out of the box: six official MCP servers (filesystem, fetch, git, memory, sequential-thinking, time), the document skills (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx), and starter presets you can install and remix. Publish your own with a pull request.

changelog.title: The registry is live
changelog.blurb: Metis now has a community registry: publish skills, presets, and pipelines with a pull request. The model catalog also lives here, so new models reach every install without an app update.

community.title: Dev-tool MCPs join the roster
community.blurb: GitHub, Postgres, SQLite, and Sentry connections mean a pipeline can now read issues, query a database, and triage errors without leaving Metis.

community.title: Browser automation, two ways
community.blurb: Playwright (official, Microsoft-maintained) and Puppeteer are both in the Marketplace now — pick whichever fits your automation pipeline.

community.title: MCP connections landed
community.blurb: Six official Model Context Protocol servers are now one click away in the Marketplace, each with a ready-to-edit connection config.

community.title: Document skills published
community.blurb: docx, pdf, pptx, and xlsx skills so a pipeline can turn notes into polished deliverables. Pair them with the Docs Factory preset.

community.title: SlopSec published
community.blurb: lachydotmcg's security-audit skill for vibe-coded SaaS apps is live in the registry — 50 common ways AI-built apps get pwned, as a repeatable checklist with severity scoring.

news.title: Local-first routing keeps your tokens (and your data) at home
news.blurb: Quality, cost, and quota routing in one policy — escalate to the cloud only when a prompt truly needs it.

news.title: Model Context Protocol: what the servers actually do
news.blurb: The official reference servers, now installable from the Marketplace.
